prompts.title: Audit and plan a project end to end
prompts.text: Use the audit-to-execution skill from https://github.com/tbachir/bag/tree/main/skills/audit-to-execution. Read BAG's root AGENTS.md and the skill, and my project's instructions. Audit the current state, research alternatives, create a verifiable cahier des charges, ROADMAP.md and TODO.md with stable IDs, recommended skills per task, implementation plan and reviewable PR when authorized. Do not merge or deploy.

prompts.title: Reconcile existing roadmap and work status
prompts.text: Use audit-to-execution from https://github.com/tbachir/bag/tree/main/skills/audit-to-execution after reading BAG root AGENTS.md and the target project's instructions. Reconcile STATUS.md, current CI/PR, TODO.md, ROADMAP.md and ADRs against actual evidence. Preserve completed work and stable IDs; do not check unverified tasks.

prompts.title: Discover skills for every task
prompts.text: Use audit-to-execution from https://github.com/tbachir/bag/tree/main/skills/audit-to-execution after reading BAG root AGENTS.md. Search the open skills ecosystem via find-skills and primary docs, not only BAG. For each actionable TODO task, recommend up to two reviewed skills and a discovery query, distinguishing installed vs suggested. Do not install unreviewed scripts.
